hardOrderingNotes: C20 canonical execution and D5=600 readback strictly precede C12 scheduling or authorization; not only a queue event.
D1 createMarket makes each market active immediately; keep D4/D6 maintenance closed and deactivate each market with a separate canonical operation before cutover.
D1 config pause must follow market/deviation configuration because it blocks admin setters.
Future market activation requires separately authorized owner unpause of D1 global and config pause, market-status change, and config re-pause while D4/D6 remain closed.
Safe scheduling and Timelock execution are independent approvals/receipts for every governed node; no ETA or Safe nonce is fixed here.
Migration seeds occur before irreversible seal; shared D4 grants follow seal under the reviewed transition manifest.
D6 runtime executor grant and inventory check precede Timelock bootstrap executor removal; PME remains paused.
No initial maintenance release until sealed migration, ACLs, fresh-domain guard, and separate closed-test approval.
